ops.title: Captain Hook shared skills are host-aware and staged
ops.body:
Outcome

Made the three exposed shared Captain Hook workflows host-aware without reducing their Claude Code behavior or omitting any skill. Source is uncommitted and frozen for the final build.

Host contract

- `bootstrapping-hooks`, `translating-styleguides`, and `scanning-sessions` now choose one host matrix before acting: Claude Code uses `.claude/hooks` with `uvx --isolated capt-hook`; Codex uses `.capt-hook/hooks` with `capt-hook --host codex`.
- Bootstrap documents the actual Codex `init`, explicit `review enable` and `review disable`, installed-plugin trust requirement, additive hook discovery, validation command, logs, and no-extra-wiring behavior.
- Interactive bootstrap and style translation retain `AskUserQuestion` for Claude Code. Codex asks the same concrete question directly and waits, without assuming that tool exists.
- Styleguide output paths, verification, and Tier 3 reference material use `<hooks-dir>` and `<capt-hook>` consistently.
- The headless session reviewer uses host-specific project hooks, source-tree verification, candidate commands, transcript fallbacks, overlap checks, PR templates, lifecycle updates, and active-hook inventory. Its directly followed `pr-workflow.md` and `review-cli.md` references inherit the same placeholders.
- Skill delegation uses the host's available skill mechanism and falls back to reading the referenced skill instructions when no invocation tool exists.

Validation

- Confirmed live CLI spelling with `capt-hook --host codex` help for `init`, `test`, `pack test`, `review enable`, `review threshold-check`, `review slots`, and `review update` including `--pr-title`.
- `UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run pytest tests/test_host_aware_skills.py tests/test_skills.py tests/test_codex_packaging.py`: 34 passed.
- `UV_NO_SYNC=1 uv run ruff check tests/test_host_aware_skills.py`: passed.
- `slop-cop check <file> --lang=markdown` ran on all six changed Markdown files; it reported advisory findings in the existing long-form skill prose.
- The source skill-creator validator rejects the pre-existing Claude `argument-hint` extension as an unknown key. The Codex generator intentionally removes `argument-hint` and `allowed-tools`; every generated staged skill validates successfully.

Generated package inspection

Accepted generated root: `/Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/captain-hook-frozen-2/plugins/captain-hook`.

- All three generated `SKILL.md` bodies match frozen source byte-for-byte after the frontmatter boundary.
- The three edited references match frozen source byte-for-byte.
- Generated frontmatter omits `allowed-tools` and `argument-hint` while retaining the host-aware descriptions.
- `bootstrapping-hooks`, `translating-styleguides`, and `scanning-sessions` each report `Skill is valid!` from the skill-creator validator.
- The first generated root, `captain-hook-frozen-1`, was rejected because it predated the final `--transcript PATH` frontmatter correction; `frozen-2` supersedes it.

Limits

No packaging, manifest, version, runtime, global configuration, plugin cache, live application, or neighboring repository was changed. No commit or publication was made. The final integrated build and installation remain coordinator-owned.
